title: Tesla Halloween Mode
summary:
Trick or treaters beware 👻

Enable Trick or Treat in Halloween Mode and your Tesla will play spooky sounds & lights when visitors approach. Rolling out now in an over-the-air software update

To enable:  Toybox → Halloween Mode → Trick or Treat
